newsitem.title: USA: Reuters launches North American Power.
newsitem.headline: Reuters launches North American Power.

text.p: Reuters America Inc announced Wednesday its launch of North American Power, a real-time news and information service focusing on the U.S. and Canadian power industry.
"The product provides tailored news and market data from the natural gas and electricity markets to meet the information needs of users in those segments," the company said in a statement.

The service will include real-time news from a Reuters team of specialist power reporters, comprehensive prices including cash and futures, historical charting, customized coverage of weather conditions and forecasts, and market statistics including weekly power production and gas storage.
It aims to serve a wide cross-section of users including utilities, independent power producers, power marketers, industrial consumers, investment banks and energy brokers.

Reuters, the leading screen-based provider of energy information, has been serving the needs of the energy industry since 1984. Its current offerings include Energy 2000, a real-time information product covering the global energy industry.
Reuters America Inc is the primary operating division in the Americas of Reuters Holdings PLC.

Reuters supplies the global business community and news media with real-time financial data, transaction systems, information management systems, access to numerical and textual historical databases, news graphics, photos and news video.
